mapper.sql: /*汇率信息*/ SELECT BASIS_CYY ccyOriginal, QUOT_CYY ccyConvert, TRADE_DATE publishDate, case when #{exchangeSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '02' then CLOSE_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{exchangeSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '01' then OPEN_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{exchangeSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '03' then HIGH_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{exchangeSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '04' then LOW_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{exchangeSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '05' then MID_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) end yeid FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE info where info.QUOT_CYY = 'CNY' AND INFO.DATASOURCE_TYPE = 'SAFE' and info.TRADE_DATE = (select max(t.TRADE_DATE) from MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE t where t.BASIS_CYY = info.BASIS_CYY and t.QUOT_CYY = info.QUOT_CYY AND t.DATASOURCE_TYPE = 'SAFE' and t.TRADE_DATE <=#{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE})
mapper.insert: insert into pbc_month_prd_position( POSUUID, PRODID, ORG_CODE, STARTDATE, ENDDATE, BOOKDATE, IS_CONSTRACTE, TRANSFER_TYPE, BUY_PLACE, OPERATE_MODE, RAISEMODE, IVSTORIENTATION, MANAGE_TYPE, FIDUCIARY_DUTY, DURATIONFLAG, IS_MARKET_FUND, VDATE, PAYSTATUS, TERM, CCY, CUSTOMER_TYPE2, ENDAMTSUM_OTH, DIRTYAMTSUM, REDAMT, DIRTYQTY, REDQTY, ENDQTYSUM, END_DAYS, REDCOST, ENDCOST) SELECT f_guid() posuuid /*主键*/, info.prod_id prodid,/*产品代码*/ info.org_code orgcode,/*产品所属机构代码*/ #{reportStartDate,jdbcType=DATE} startdate,/*报表开始日期*/ #{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE}enddate,/*报表结束日期*/ #{batchDate,jdbcType=DATE} bookdate,/*统计日期*/ info.is_constracte isconstracte,/*是否分级产品*/ /*--info.prodtype prodtype,产品标识*/ info.transfer_type transfertype,/*转让类型*/ deal.buy_place buyplace,/*销售区域*/ info.operate_mode operatemode,/*运行方式*/ info.raise_type raisemode,/*募集方式*/ info.ivstorientation ivstorientation,/*投资性质*/ info.manage_type managetype,/*管理方式*/ info.fiduciary_duty fiduciaryduty,/*受托职责*/ CASE when info.dealcounts>0 and info.terminatecounts=0 then '01' when info.dealcounts>0 and info.terminatecounts>0 then '02' when info.dealcounts=0 and info.Issuing_Status='01' then '01' else '03' END durationflag,/*存续状态*/ info.is_market_fund ismarketfund,/*货币市场基金*/ info.vdate,/*起息日*/ case when info.terminatecounts>0 then CASE WHEN info.REALMDATE=info.settdate_date then '01' WHEN info.REALMDATE>info.settdate_date then '02' else '03' end else case when INFO.REALMDATE <= #{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE} then '04' else null end END paystatus,/*兑付状态*/ case when info.operate_mode in ('03','04') then '0' else timestampdiff(DAY, info.vdate ,info.mdate) end term,/*合同期限*/ /*TRIM(ifnull(deal.ccy,baseinfo.RAISE_CCY)) ccy,*/ /*若币种取值与产品基本信息表，取前三位*/ ifnull(deal.ccy, (case when baseinfo.RAISE_CCY is NULL then NULL else substring(baseinfo.RAISE_CCY, 1, 3) end)) ccy,/*币种*/ deal.customer_type2 customertype2,/*客户二级类型*/ deal.endqtysum*(case when #{isPre,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '02' then deal.prod_value else (case when #{jsbankStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '01' then TRUNCATE(deal.prod_value,5) when #{jsbankStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '02' then ROUND(deal.prod_value,5) end) end)*ifnull(rate.yeid,1) ENDAMTSUM_OTH,/*期末余额*/ deal.dirtyamtsum dirtyamtsum,/*募集金额*/ deal.redamt redamt,/*兑付金额*/ deal.raiseqty raiseqty,/*当期募集份额*/ deal.payqty payqty,/*当期兑付份额*/ deal.endqtysum endqtysum,/*剩余份额*/ CASE WHEN info.operate_mode IN ('01','02') THEN greatest( (case when (DATEDIFF(info.mdate,date_format(#{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d'))) < 0 then 1 else DATEDIFF(info.mdate,date_format(#{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')) end), 0) ELSE ( CASE WHEN info.plancounts = 0 THEN 1 /*开放计划条数为0，表示高频开放*/ ELSE greatest( (case when DATEDIFF(ifnull(info.minopenstart,info.mdate), date_format(#{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')) < 0 then 1 else DATEDIFF(ifnull(info.minopenstart,info.mdate),date_format(#{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')) end), 0) END ) END end_days,/*剩余期限*/ deal.redcost, /*当期到期本金*/ case when deal.endqtysum = 0 then 0 else deal.endcost end endcost/*剩余成本*/ FROM () info LEFT JOIN () deal ON deal.prodid = info.prod_id left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO baseinfo on baseinfo.PROD_ID=info.prod_id left join ()rate on deal.yieldccy = rate.ccyOriginal where baseinfo.status in ('E','M')

insert into pbc_month_prd_position( POSUUID ,PRODID ,ORG_CODE ,STARTDATE ,ENDDATE ,BOOKDATE ,IS_CONSTRACTE ,TRANSFER_TYPE ,BUY_PLACE ,OPERATE_MODE ,RAISEMODE ,IVSTORIENTATION ,MANAGE_TYPE ,FIDUCIARY_DUTY ,DURATIONFLAG ,IS_MARKET_FUND ,VDATE ,PAYSTATUS ,TERM ,CCY ,CUSTOMER_TYPE2 ,ENDAMTSUM_OTH ,DIRTYAMTSUM ,REDAMT ,DIRTYQTY ,REDQTY ,ENDQTYSUM ,END_DAYS , REDCOST , ENDCOST)
/*头寸计算：几个金额的计算，以产品id，币种，客户二级类型，销售区域分组*/ WITH pos AS ( select ds.* ,ifnull(pv.prod_value,1) prod_value ,/*产品最新净值*/ pv.ccy yieldccy/*报价币种*/ from ( SELECT prodid, ccy, customer_type2, buy_place, SUM(dirtyamtsum) dirtyamtsum, /*当期募集金额*/ SUM(redamt) redamt, /*当期兑付金额*/ SUM(raiseqty) raiseqty, /*当期募集份额*/ SUM(payqty) payqty, /*当期兑付份额*/ SUM(redcost) redcost, /*当期到期本金*/ SUM(endcost) endcost, /*剩余成本*/ SUM(endqtysum) endqtysum /*期末份额*/ FROM ( /*上周期头寸*/ SELECT prodid, ccy, customer_type2, buy_place, 0 dirtyamtsum, 0 redamt, 0 raiseqty, 0 payqty, 0 redcost, endcost, endqtysum FROM pbc_month_prd_position WHERE ENDDATE between ADD_MONTHS(#{reportStartDate,jdbcType=DATE},-1) and #{reportStartDate,jdbcType=DATE} UNION ALL /*本周期头寸*/ SELECT dl.FINPROD_ID prodid, decode(dl.CCY,'036','AUD','124','CAD','156','CNY','344','HKD','392','JPY','826','GBP','840','USD','978','EUR') ccy, dl.CUSTOMER_TYPE2 customer_type2, BUY_PLACE, SUM( CASE WHEN dl.DEALTYPE IN('1', '2', '5') THEN dl.DEALAMT ELSE 0 END ) dirtyamtsum, SUM( CASE WHEN #{dividendReinvestmentFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '01' THEN CASE WHEN dl.DEALTYPE IN('4', '5', '3','6') THEN dl.DEALAMT ELSE 0 END ELSE CASE WHEN dl.DEALTYPE IN('4', '3','6') THEN dl.DEALAMT ELSE 0 END END ) redamt, SUM( CASE WHEN dl.DEALTYPE IN('1', '2', '5') THEN dl.PRINQTY ELSE 0 END ) raiseqty, SUM( CASE WHEN dl.DEALTYPE IN('3', '6') THEN dl.PRINQTY ELSE 0 END ) payqty, SUM( CASE WHEN dl.DEALTYPE = '6' THEN dl.RED_COST ELSE 0 END ) redcost, SUM(DECODE(dl.DEALTYPE, '1', dl.DEALAMT, '2', dl.DEALAMT, '5', dl.DEALAMT, - 1 * ifnull(dl.RED_COST,0))) endcost, SUM(DECODE(dl.DEALTYPE, '1', dl.PRINQTY, '2', dl.PRINQTY, '5', dl.PRINQTY, - 1 * dl.PRINQTY)) endqtysum FROM P_INTERF_PRO_CUSTOM_DEAL dl WHERE 1 = 1 AND to_date(dl.DEALDATE,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN #{reportStartDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND #{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND dl.DEALTYPE != '4'
GROUP BY FINPROD_ID, ccy, CUSTOMER_TYPE2, BUY_PLACE ) GROUP BY prodid, ccy, CUSTOMER_TYPE2, BUY_PLACE ) ds /*产品净值*/ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT prod_value, ifnull(fprod_id, prod_id) prod_id,ccy FROM ( SELECT RANK() OVER( PARTITION BY prod_id,ifnull(ccy,'CNY') ORDER BY change_date DESC ) my_rank, fprod_id, prod_id, ifnull(ccy,'CNY') ccy, prod_value FROM chb_prd_periodyield WHERE 1 = 1 and CHANGE_DATE <= #{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND chang_type = '01' AND status in ('E' ,'M')/*收益率添加修改状态*/ ) WHERE my_rank = 1 ) pv ON ds.prodid = pv.prod_id /*and ds.ccy=pv.ccy*/ ) /*汇率信息*/ ,rate as( SELECT BASIS_CYY ccyOriginal, QUOT_CYY ccyConvert, TRADE_DATE publishDate, case when #{exchangeSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '02' then CLOSE_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{exchangeSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '01' then OPEN_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{exchangeSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '03' then HIGH_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{exchangeSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '04' then LOW_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{exchangeSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '05' then MID_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) end yeid FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE info where info.QUOT_CYY = 'CNY' and info.TRADE_DATE = (select max(t.TRADE_DATE) from MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE t where t.BASIS_CYY = info.BASIS_CYY and t.QUOT_CYY = info.QUOT_CYY and t.TRADE_DATE <=#{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE}) ) /*产品信息：产品基本信息，产品最新净值，产品开放计划信息，产品的交易信息*/ , prod AS ( SELECT info.prod_id, info.org_code, info.is_constracte,/*是否分级产品*/ info.prodtype,/*产品标识*/ info.is_market_fund,/*货币市场基金*/ info.transfer_type,/*转让类型*/ info.operate_mode,/*运行方式*/ info.raise_type,/*募集方式*/ info.ivstorientation,/*投资性质*/ info.manage_type,/*管理方式*/ info.fiduciary_duty,/*受托职责*/ info.vdate,/*起息日*/ info.mdate,/*合同期限*/ info.terminatedate /*终止日期*/ ,ifnull(sch.plancounts,0) plancounts /*开放计划条数*/ ,sch.minopenstart minopenstart /*最小开放日*/ ,ifnull(dealstat.dealcounts,0) dealcounts /*交易条数*/ ,ifnull(dealstat.terminatecounts,0) terminatecounts /*终止交易条数*/ ,dealstat.settdate_date /*终止交易确认日*/ ,info.issuing_status /*存续状态*/ FROM /*产品基本信息*/ chb_prd_baseinfo info /*开放计划*/ left join ( SELECT a.prod_id, ifnull(a.plancounts,0) plancounts, b.minopenstart FROM ( SELECT COUNT(1) plancounts, prod_id FROM chb_prd_opensch WHERE status in ('E','M') GROUP BY prod_id ) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MIN(open_start) minopenstart, prod_id FROM chb_prd_opensch WHERE status in ('E','M') AND open_start > #{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY prod_id ) b ON a.prod_id = b.prod_id ) sch on sch.prod_id = info.prod_id /*交易统计：产品的交易条数，23交易的条数，23交易的交易日*/ left join( SELECT a.prod_id, ifnull(a.dealcounts,0) dealcounts, ifnull(b.terminatecounts,0) terminatecounts, b.settdate_date FROM ( SELECT FINPROD_ID prod_id, COUNT(1) dealcounts FROM P_INTERF_PRO_CUSTOM_DEAL WHERE to_date(DEALDATE,'%Y%m%d') <= #{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY FINPROD_ID ) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FINPROD_ID prod_id, MAX(to_date(DEALDATE,'%Y%m%d')) settdate_date, COUNT(1) terminatecounts FROM P_INTERF_PRO_CUSTOM_DEAL WHERE DEALTYPE = '6' and to_date(DEALDATE,'%Y%m%d') <= #{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY FINPROD_ID ) b ON a.prod_id = b.prod_id ) dealstat on dealstat.prod_id=info.prod_id WHERE info.fprod_id IS NULL
AND INFO.PROD_ID IN
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND INFO.VDATE <= #{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE} /*历史到期产品不统计*/ AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM P_INTERF_PRO_CUSTOM_DEAL d WHERE d.DEALTYPE = '6' AND d.FINPROD_ID = info.prod_id AND to_date(d.DEALDATE,'%Y%m%d') < #{reportStartDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) )
SELECT f_guid() posuuid /*主键*/, info.prod_id prodid,/*产品代码*/ info.org_code orgcode,/*产品所属机构代码*/ #{reportStartDate,jdbcType=DATE} startdate,/*报表开始日期*/ #{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE}enddate,/*报表结束日期*/ #{batchDate,jdbcType=DATE} bookdate,/*统计日期*/ DECODE(info.is_constracte, 'Y', '01', '02') isconstracte,/*是否分级产品*/ /*--info.prodtype prodtype,产品标识*/ info.transfer_type transfertype,/*转让类型*/ deal.buy_place buyplace,/*销售区域*/ info.operate_mode operatemode,/*运行方式*/ info.raise_type raisemode,/*募集方式*/ info.ivstorientation ivstorientation,/*投资性质*/ info.manage_type managetype,/*管理方式*/ info.fiduciary_duty fiduciaryduty,/*受托职责*/ CASE when info.dealcounts>0 and info.terminatecounts=0 then '01' when info.dealcounts>0 and info.terminatecounts>0 then '02' when info.dealcounts=0 and info.Issuing_Status='01' then '01' else '03' END durationflag,/*存续状态*/ info.is_market_fund ismarketfund,/*货币市场基金*/ info.vdate,/*起息日*/ case when info.terminatecounts>0 then CASE WHEN info.mdate=info.settdate_date then '01' WHEN info.mdate>info.settdate_date then '02' else '03' end else case when INFO.MDATE <= #{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE} then '04' else null end END paystatus,/*兑付状态*/ DECODE(info.operate_mode, '03', '0', '04', '0', info.mdate - info.vdate) term,/*合同期限*/ /*TRIM(ifnull(deal.ccy,baseinfo.RAISE_CCY)) ccy,*/ /*若币种取值与产品基本信息表，取前三位*/ ifnull(deal.ccy, DECODE(baseinfo.RAISE_CCY, NULL, NULL, SUBSTR(baseinfo.RAISE_CCY, 1, 3))) ccy,/*币种*/ deal.customer_type2 customertype2,/*客户二级类型*/ deal.endqtysum*DECODE(#{jsbankStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'01',TRUNC(deal.prod_value,5),'02',ROUND(deal.prod_value,5))*ifnull(rate.yeid,1) ENDAMTSUM_OTH,/*期末余额*/ deal.dirtyamtsum dirtyamtsum,/*募集金额*/ deal.redamt redamt,/*兑付金额*/ deal.raiseqty raiseqty,/*当期募集份额*/ deal.payqty payqty,/*当期兑付份额*/ deal.endqtysum endqtysum,/*剩余份额*/ CASE WHEN info.operate_mode IN ('01','02') THEN greatest(info.mdate - #{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE}, 0) ELSE ( CASE WHEN info.plancounts = 0 THEN 1 /*开放计划条数为0，表示高频开放*/ ELSE greatest(ifnull(info.minopenstart,info.mdate)- #{reportEndDate,jdbcType=DATE}, 0) END ) END end_days,/*剩余期限*/ deal.redcost, /*当期到期本金*/ DECODE(deal.endqtysum, 0, 0, deal.endcost) endcost/*剩余成本*/ FROM prod info LEFT JOIN pos deal ON deal.prodid = info.prod_id left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO baseinfo on baseinfo.PROD_ID=info.prod_id left join rate on deal.yieldccy = rate.ccyOriginal
